soh: battery state of health, percent of new
v2l: powering outside devices from the traction battery
mah: unit of charge capacity of small batteries
ah: charge capacity; Wh = Ah x volts
gas: fuel; for an EV, battery charge or range
engine: EV: the traction motor (no combustion engine)
capacity: battery energy storage (kWh), not current charge
brake temperature: brake disc and pad temperature (concept brake_temperature), not wear
ecu reset: event: a control unit restarted (concept ecu_reset)
adas state change: event: assist switched on or off (concept adas_state_change)
diagnostic code cleared: event: a fault code was cleared (concept diagnostic_code_cleared)
source dropout: event: a data source stopped sending (concept source_dropout)
service log: vehicle service log lines (concept service_log), searched by words
